text: Really sorry to message this late, I know you must be busy with proper emergencies. My son is 4 months old and I think he's coming down with a cold. His temperature is 37.8, I took it twice to be sure. His nose is runny and then other times it seems blocked up, and he's been sneezing a fair bit since yesterday. I'm not sure if that number counts as a fever for a baby his age or if I'm overthinking it, it's our first and my partner's asleep so I've got nobody to ask. I don't really know what's normal with a cold at this age. Again, sorry for bothering you, I just wanted to check I'm not missing something.
